verses.3745: yāquṭbu yāghawthu yā mawlāyā yāwazaru yā muntahā ʾamalī billāhi yā qamaru
verses.3746: yā wal-yā ṣ-ṣulḥi fī ḥālī muḥawwilahu ʾilā s-sadādi falā yaʾatī liyā ḍ-ḍararu
verses.3747: yā muqriba l-ʿabdi lil-mawlā muwaṣṣilahu yā man yaʾummu ʾilā ʾaknāfihi l-basharu
verses.3748: yāmuqtaḍā l-ḥāli fī ḥarfi n-nidāʾi wa yā ghiyātha kulli munādi ʿindahu waṭaru
verses.3749: yā sirru yā ʾamnu yā maʾawāyā kulli ʾadhā wa yā ʾamānu wa yā manwāyā yā fakharu
verses.3750: yā dhukhru yā yusru yā kanza l-ʿufāti wa yā makhtūmu maktūmu yā maʿlūmu tushtaharu
verses.3751: wayā mumiddu ʾabā l-fāḍi l-ʾilāhī wayā mawlāyā yā ʾaḥmada t-tijāni yā wazaru
verses.3752: wa yā qudwatī yā ʾimāmī ḥuẓwatī wamalā dhī kaʿbaha l-ḥāji lil-muḥtāji yā ḥajaru
verses.3753: naṭūfu ḥawlaka maʿnā kay nuʿʿada mina ṭ-ṭuwāfi ḥawlaka ḥissā rabbahum shakaru
verses.3754: ʾinna l-ʾighāthata fīka l-buʿdu yusriʿuhā taʿẓīma qadrika ʿinda llāhi yā qamru
verses.3755: wa fāḍu rāḥatika l-muthlā lijūdikumu falaysa yushbihuhu baḥru wa lā maṭaru
verses.3756: lam yabki bāki ʾatākum mushtaki farajā ʾillā wa furrija ʿanhu l-ghammu wa ḍ-ḍararu
verses.3757: ʾanta l-malādhu ʾidhā mā shtadda min julali ʾanta l-maʿādhu ʾidhā l-ʾahwālu tuntashiru
verses.3758: ʾanta l-muʿīnu wa ʾanta l-mustaghāthu wa ʾanta l-mustaʿānu wa yanḥū naḥwaka z-zumaru
verses.3759: falam taḍiʿ ʾanfusu tarʿā birawḍatikum taʾawī ʾilā thamarāti d-dīni taḥtajiru
verses.3760: lā tantahī shakwatu minnī liʿiṭfikumu liʾanna jūdaka lā yafnā wa lā yadharu
verses.3761: tarku shtikāʾī ḥarāmu ʿindakum ʾabadā yā qāḍiyā l-ḥāji fāqḍi l-ḥāja taqtadaru
verses.3762: ʿalā n-nabī ṣafiyyī llāhi sayyidinā wal-ʾāli waṣ-ṣaḥbi ʾarbābi l-hudā ftakharu
verses.3763: ṣalātu rabbī salāmu llāhi khāliqinā mā dhikrahu dh-dhākirūna llāha qad dhakaru
